title: Short exact section-square sequence on a chosen injective resolution
statement: Let C be an abelian category with enough injectives [def-sp-abelian, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let S be a commutative square of four additive functors A,B,C,D from C to abelian groups [def-sp-left-exact-additive], with edges a:A->B, b:A->C, c:B->D, d:C->D and ac=bd. Assume the diagonal (a,b) is injective on every injective object, the sequence with maps (a,b) and c-d is exact on every injective object, and c-d is surjective on every injective object. For each F choose its canonical injective resolution F -> I^bullet. Form the three-term sequence of complexes A(I^bullet) -> (B x C)(I^bullet) -> D(I^bullet), with the indicated diagonal and difference termwise. This resolutionSequence is short exact in every degree, hence short exact as complexes. Define its transported boundary b_S(F,n):R^n D(F)->R^{n+1} A(F) by composing the resolution comparison from R^n D(F) to H^n(D(I^bullet)), the canonical complex connecting map [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact], and the inverse resolution comparison to R^{n+1} A(F). All this data, including the short-exactness proof and the transported boundary definition, is implemented without sorry.

proof.text: Construct the pointwise product of the two middle additive group-valued functors using actual Cartesian products of their underlying groups. The diagonal natural transformation is (f12,f13), and the difference natural transformation is f24-f34. Naturality of these transformations follows coordinatewise from naturality of the four square edges. Their composite is zero by the square commutation relation.

Choose the canonical injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Apply the diagonal and difference termwise using NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex, giving resolutionSequence S F. Evaluate at each n. The first and last groups are A(I^n) and D(I^n), and the middle group is literally B(I^n) x C(I^n), with the diagonal and difference as maps. Since I^n is injective, the three assumptions of the bundled square supply Function.Injective, Function.Exact, Function.Surjective. Convert these by AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective, ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact, and AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective to a short exact sequence of groups. HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact gives short exactness of resolutionSequence; this entire proof is implemented and compiling.
